servicesHeadline: Everything we do, and what it costs

services.name: Hand wash and spray wax
services.desc: Body, wheels, tires and windows. About an hour.

services.name: Interior shampoo
services.desc: Seats and carpet shampooed and extracted. Dry by dinner in summer.

services.desc: Our most booked job. See La Completa below.

services.name: Headlight restore

pricing.headline: Three ways to book us
pricing.sub: Car and small SUV prices. Trucks and third-row SUVs add $30, and we tell you before we start.
pricing.fine: Cash, card, Zelle or Venmo. Pay when you've seen the car.

packages.name: La Completa
features: Dash, doors and vents wiped and protected

steps.title: Text us a photo
steps.body: Of the car, inside and out. We reply with the price and two or three times that work.

steps.title: We pull up
steps.body: Driveway, curb or your office lot. Shade tent goes up, generator stays quiet.

steps.title: You check it before you pay
steps.body: Walk around it with us. If something's not right, we fix it right there.

blocks.title: Rudy, Mateo, and a white Ford Transit
body: I started washing cars at my uncle's lot on Zarzamora in 1998. In 2011 I bought a used van, a water tank and a generator, and painted our name on the door myself.
Mateo joined me after he finished at Southwest High. He does the interiors, and he's pickier than I am.
We don't send crews we don't know. When you book, it's one of us two at your door, every time.

reviews.headline: What people on our route say

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Mateo got three years of soccer season out of my back seat. Showed up at 6:30 like they said.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Price on the website is the price he charged. Truck was done before I finished my calls.

items.name: Sample customer
items.text: Le hablé en español a Don Rudy y me explicó todo. Muy buen trabajo.

guarantee.title: Missed a spot? We come back.
guarantee.body: Text us a photo within 48 hours and we'll come back and fix it, free. That's been the deal since the first day.

areas.headline: Our route, inside 1604
areas.body: Outside the loop? Text us. We go to Boerne and New Braunfels on Saturdays for a $25 trip fee.

booking.headline: Pick a package, get a time
booking.body: Two quick steps. Rudy texts you back with a time, usually within the hour.

lead.question: What does the car need?
lead.notesHint: Year, make and model, and anything we should know (dog hair, kid stuff)

faqHeadline: Questions we get on the driveway

faq.q: Do you need my water or electricity?
faq.a: No. We carry 100 gallons of water and our own generator.
We text the night before and move you to the next open day. No fee.

faq.q: Can you work at my office?
faq.a: Yes, if the lot allows it. Leave us the keys at the front desk and we'll text when it's done.
Sí. Rudy y Mateo hablan español e inglés. Escríbanos por texto como guste.
Cash, card, Zelle or Venmo, after you've looked the car over.

final.headline: Your driveway, this week.
final.sub: Text a photo of the car and we'll send back a price and a time.
